description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Stunning Home:* Views of the Gulf from the Deck* Bikes Included* Located on the south side of 30A* Short walk to the beach* Community Pool*This property is not available to adults under the age of 25. No Exceptions. **We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Grouper Therapy is your ultimate beach retreat, perfectly designed for relaxation and adventure. Nestled in the heart of 30A, this spacious home comfortably sleeps 16 guests, making it ideal for family gatherings or a friends' getaway. With 2 King beds, 1 Queen, 2 Full beds, 2 Twin beds, and 4 Bunk beds, there's plenty of room for everyone to unwind. Start your mornings with a cup of coffee on the expansive decks, soaking in the breathtaking Gulf views. Spend your days lounging by the community pool next door, or hop on one of the 4 provided bikes to explore the nearby attractions, including Seaside and The Big Chill.Whether you're sunbathing, exploring the vibrant 30A community, or simply relaxing with loved ones, Grouper Therapy offers the perfect setting for an unforgettable beach vacation. Book your Saturday-to-Saturday stay during the peak summer season and experience the best of 30A living!Saturday to Saturday rental during the peak summer season.Seagrove Beach is "in the middle of it all" that Scenic 30A has to offer! Of course, the beautiful beaches are the top attraction, but Seagrove is also home to 2 coastal dune lakes (Eastern Lake and Deer Lake) that are perfect for kayaking, paddle boarding, and eco-sploring. Just like the rest of 30A, Seagrove is also home to many locally owned restaurants showcasing the local catch, boutique and specialty shopping venues, several golf courses are nearby, and the convenience of a full-service Publix (grocery) store is tucked away behind the lush greenery the community has to offer. A few of our favorite restaurants are the Perfect Pig, walking distance from Grouper Therapy, The Old Florida Fish House, and Whiskey Bravo. If all the above is not enough, then Destin, that is known as "the worlds luckiest fishing village" is just about 20 miles to the west.Bed Setup:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: 2 Twin/Full Bunk BedsHallway: 2 Twin Bunk BedsRestaurants nearby- Old Florida Fish House, Cafe 30A, Crust at the Hub, Bud and Alley's Waterfront Restaurant and Bar, The Perfect Pig, and Pickle's Snack Station.30A is a fantastic destination, the beaches are some of the worlds best with sugar-white sand and emerald-green waters. You will find plenty of beach accesses along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Seaside is a short drive away and is most widely known for being featured in The Truman Show with Jim Carrey. Its incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has a Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Greenway station is 30A's newest destination for gathering, shopping, and dining in Seagrove Beach. Greenway Station features known retailers Wild Olives Tapas and Wine Bar, Pecan Jack's Ice Cream, Coast Hippie, and YOLO Board + Bike, plus introduces Local Cantina Mexican Restaurant, Souper Jenny Coffee Roasters, Canopy Road Cafe, and more.The Big Chill offers something for folks of all ages and tastes, from tacos and tequila to wings, burgers, and shakes, a stop here is quick, tasty, and convenient, and comes with a side of entertainment at the outdoor amphitheater. It's a great place to catch a concert, sporting event, or a movie on the lawn.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
